verdict.rationale: Gitleaks exposes generic hooks (pre-commit script, stdin scanning, CI Action with PR comments) that a user could wire into an AI coding-agent workflow to scan generated code before it lands, but there is no evidence of any purpose-built integration, plugin, or API for coding agents specifically. missing for 10: explicit AI-agent/IDE-agent integration or SDK, evidence of agents actually invoking gitleaks pre-merge, any first-party guidance for agent workflows.
